textrank_config.similarity: unique shared Unicode units divided by log sentence lengths
textrank_config.token_unit: Unicode letter/number units, usually Vietnamese syllables
textrank_config.convergence_measure: L1 difference between consecutive score vectors
textrank_config.duplicate_handling: keep first sentence after NFC, whitespace and lowercase
textrank_config.selection: greedy whole sentences within content-token budget; restore source order
textrank_config.overflow_fallback: truncate highest-ranked sentence only if no whole sentence fits
textrank_config.single_unit_similarity: shared unit count when both log lengths are zero

selection_basis: user selection after validation; before reading test
